entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, and flake investigation context

Added IsWatermarked:bool field to CatalogElement record; bumped schemaVersion to 1.1 in CrawlerOrchestrator.WriteManifest
Created WatermarkDetector.cs — source-level scan of .razor files for @page + @inherits TrackedComponentBase; uses RouteEnumerator.NormalizeTemplatePath to strip type constraints
Verified via unit tests that /admin/products (ProductManagement.razor has both directives) gets IsWatermarked=true and /dashboard gets false; actual re-crawl deferred to compose stack availability
Created ComponentCatalogCrawler.Tests project; 8 tests covering direct inheritance, no-page sub-component, parameterised route normalisation, nested subdirectory, missing directory — all pass

Read planning docs (project-guidance, lessons-learned, authoring-guide), spec, sibling repo CLAUDE.md, dabbler-uat-dsl grammar/AST/visitor/emitter/tests

Extended DabblerUatDsl.g4: added waitForActionsQuietStep rule (WAIT FOR ACTIONS QUIET), inserted before waitForStep in step alternatives; added ACTIONS and QUIET keyword tokens; updated header comment with the new verb

Added WaitForActionsQuietStep record to Ast/Nodes.cs; added VisitWaitForActionsQuietStep override to UatDslVisitor.cs; semantic validator unchanged (the verb has no labels so DescribeProbe falls through cleanly)
Added WaitForActionsQuietStep case to PlaywrightCSharpEmitter.EmitStep emitting exactly: await fixture.WaitForQuietAsync(page);

Added 4 grammar tests (basic parse, lowercase, missing QUIET fails, distinct-from-quoted-WAIT-FOR), 1 AST test (node construction + ToCanonicalText), 2 emitter tests (emits exact line; emits regardless of EmitWatermarkWaits flag)

Bumped Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Core and Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Emitters.Playwright.CSharp to 1.1.0; produced pack-output/Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Core.1.1.0.nupkg and pack-output/Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Emitters.Playwright.CSharp.1.1.0.nupkg

Added Hard Requirement #8 to uat-script-author prompt: emit WAIT FOR ACTIONS QUIET after every interaction verb on routes whose catalog IsWatermarked=true; positive (/admin/products) + negative (/dashboard) examples included

Re-crawled component catalog (schemaVersion 1.1; /admin/products entries now carry isWatermarked=true; /dashboard false). Routed uat-script-author for a /admin/products toggle-Available smoke; LLM correctly emitted WAIT FOR ACTIONS QUIET as Step 12 immediately after Step 11 CLICK SWITCH.

Compiled compile-only-smoke.json via dabbler-uat-dsl compile (1.1.0). Output contains 'await fixture.WaitForQuietAsync(page);' for the explicit WAIT FOR ACTIONS QUIET verb (also one implicit emission via existing EmitWatermarkWaits flag - transitional debt flagged in Session 2 verification).
